title.en: Developing Presentations in a Social Media Environment
title.ms: Membangunkan Pembentangan dalam Persekitaran Media Sosial

en: Describe the tasks in analysing the situation for a presentation and organising it
Explain how to adapt to your audience and develop an effective opening, body and close
Discuss five steps for delivering a successful presentation
Explain the importance of the backchannel and list six steps for effective online presentations
ms: Huraikan tugas menganalisis situasi pembentangan dan menyusunnya
Terangkan cara menyesuaikan dengan audiens dan membina pembukaan, isi dan penutup berkesan
Bincangkan lima langkah menyampaikan pembentangan berjaya
Terangkan kepentingan backchannel dan senaraikan enam langkah pembentangan dalam talian berkesan

blocks.en: Assess the environment: four seating arrangements
blocks.ms: Nilai persekitaran: empat susunan tempat duduk

blocks.ms: Slaid 7 senaraikan item dalam lajur tanpa pemetaan jelas. Slaid 4 (Proses Tiga Langkah) ialah rajah. Maksud “Twebinar” ialah Extra (bukan dalam slaid): webinar dengan backchannel Twitter.

en: Outlined like conventional messages; follows a predefined flow
ms: Digaris seperti mesej konvensional; ikut aliran ditetapkan

en: Doesn’t flow in any particular direction; presenter can move back and forth between topics
ms: Tiada arah tertentu; penyampai boleh berpindah antara topik

en: Define the main idea: a **one-sentence summary** covering subject, purpose and audience
Limit scope: work within time constraints; hold the audience’s attention
ms: Tentukan idea utama: **ringkasan satu ayat** merangkumi subjek, tujuan dan audiens
Hadkan skop: ikut kekangan masa; kekalkan perhatian audiens

en: State the purpose and main idea
Prepare a bibliography or source notes
ms: Kenal pasti poin utama sepanjang pembentangan

en: Establish your credibility (be introduced by another person; introduce yourself humbly and simply; say why you are the right person)
Preview your message (summarise the main idea, identify major supporting points, indicate the order)
ms: Bina kredibiliti (diperkenalkan orang lain; perkenal diri dengan rendah hati dan ringkas; nyatakan kenapa anda sesuai)
Pratonton mesej (ringkaskan idea utama, kenal pasti poin sokongan, nyatakan susunan)

blocks.en: Slide 18 (titled “Arousing Audience Interest”) lists outline-preparation items, which appear copied from slide 12. Treat slide 17 as the source for the three jobs of the introduction.
blocks.ms: Slaid 18 (bertajuk “Arousing Audience Interest”) menyenaraikan item penyediaan rangka yang nampak disalin dari slaid 12. Anggap slaid 17 sebagai sumber tiga tugas pengenalan.

en: Speaking from an outline or notes

blocks.en: Practising your delivery: questions to ask

en: Can you present your material naturally?
Can you present compellingly without equipment?
Can you pronounce all the words?
Have you anticipated questions and objections?
ms: Boleh bentang bahan secara semula jadi?

en: Positive mindset; don’t worry about being perfect
Know your subject; practise, practise, practise
Be ready with your opening line; be comfortable
Concentrate on message and audience; maintain eye contact; keep going
ms: Minda positif; jangan risau mesti sempurna
Fokus pada mesej dan audiens; kekalkan pandangan mata; teruskan
Hantar isyarat bukan lisan yang yakin

blocks.en: The objective says “five steps for delivering”; the slides do not number five steps. The headings above are the slide contents.
blocks.ms: Objektif kata “lima langkah”; slaid tidak menomborkan lima langkah. Tajuk di atas ialah kandungan slaid.

blocks.en: The **backchannel** is a line of communication that the **audience creates** (for example through social media) during a presentation.
blocks.ms: **Backchannel** ialah talian komunikasi yang **dicipta audiens** (contohnya melalui media sosial) semasa pembentangan.

en: Integrate social media into the presentation process
ms: Integrasikan media sosial dalam proses pembentangan

en: Consider the audience’s point of view
Give everyone time to get connected

q.en: Three purposes of a presentation?

a.en: Inform, persuade, collaborate.
a.ms: Memaklumkan, memujuk, berkolaborasi.

q.en: Name the four basic seating arrangements.
q.ms: Namakan empat susunan tempat duduk asas.

a.en: Classroom or theatre, conference table, horseshoe or U-shaped, café seating.
a.ms: Bilik darjah/teater, meja persidangan, ladam/U, kafe.

q.en: Two things in an audience profile (slide 5)?

a.en: Emotional state; comfort level with your language.
a.ms: Keadaan emosi; keselesaan dengan bahasa.

q.en: Linear vs nonlinear structure?

a.en: Linear follows a predefined flow like a conventional message; nonlinear lets the presenter move back and forth between topics.
a.ms: Linear ikut aliran ditetapkan; nonlinear membolehkan penyampai bergerak antara topik.

q.en: What is the main idea?

a.en: A one-sentence summary covering subject, purpose and audience.
a.ms: Ringkasan satu ayat merangkumi subjek, tujuan dan audiens.

q.en: Direct or indirect for a short presentation of bad news?
q.ms: Terus atau tidak terus untuk pembentangan pendek berita buruk?

a.en: Indirect.
a.ms: Tidak terus.

q.en: Direct or indirect for a short presentation of good news?
q.ms: Terus atau tidak terus untuk berita baik pendek?

a.en: Direct.
a.ms: Terus.

q.en: Six outline preparation items?

a.en: Purpose and main idea; organise points; identify major points; plan transitions; bibliography; compelling title.
a.ms: Tujuan dan idea utama; susun poin; kenal pasti poin utama; peralihan; bibliografi; tajuk menarik.

q.en: Four steps to create a speaking outline?

a.en: Simplify the planning outline, condense points, add delivery cues, arrange your notes.
a.ms: Ringkaskan rangka, padatkan poin, tambah isyarat penyampaian, susun nota.

q.en: Tone for small groups vs large audiences?
q.ms: Nada untuk kumpulan kecil lwn audiens besar?

a.en: Small: conversational, invite comments. Large: formal, limit participation.
a.ms: Kecil: berbual, jemput komen. Besar: formal, hadkan penyertaan.

q.en: Three elements of a presentation?

a.en: Introduction, body, close.
a.ms: Pengenalan, isi, penutup.

q.en: Three jobs of the introduction?

a.en: Arouse interest, establish credibility, preview your message.
a.ms: Bangkit minat, bina kredibiliti, pratonton mesej.

q.en: How do you establish credibility?

a.en: Have another person introduce you; introduce yourself humbly and simply; explain why you are the right person.
a.ms: Diperkenalkan orang lain; perkenal diri rendah hati; nyatakan kenapa anda sesuai.

q.en: What does the close do?

a.en: Restates main points, ends with clarity and confidence, provides a clear wrap-up.
a.ms: Ulang poin utama, tamat jelas dan yakin, beri rumusan.

q.en: Four presentation methods?

a.en: Memorising, reading, speaking from an outline or notes, impromptu speaking.
a.ms: Menghafal, membaca, bercakap dari rangka/nota, impromptu.

q.en: Four ways to prepare to speak?

a.en: Plan in advance, check seating, check equipment and supplies, plan for multicultural audiences.
a.ms: Rancang awal, semak tempat duduk, semak peralatan, rancang audiens pelbagai budaya.

q.en: Name five tips for overcoming anxiety.

a.en: Positive mindset, know your subject, practise, visualise success, breathe, three-second break, eye contact, keep going.
a.ms: Minda positif, kuasai subjek, berlatih, bayangkan kejayaan, bernafas, jeda tiga saat, pandang mata, teruskan.

q.en: Four ways to speak with confidence?

a.en: Controlled beginning, confident posture, eye contact, confident nonverbal signals.
a.ms: Permulaan terkawal, postur yakin, pandang mata, isyarat bukan lisan yakin.

q.en: Six points on handling questions?

a.en: Establish ground rules, prepare, notice nonverbal signals, respond to difficult questions, control presentation, control emotions.
a.ms: Peraturan asas, bersedia, perhati isyarat bukan lisan, soalan sukar, kawal pembentangan, kawal emosi.

q.en: What is the backchannel?

a.en: A line of communication created by the audience during a presentation.
a.ms: Talian komunikasi yang dicipta audiens semasa pembentangan.

q.en: Backchannel challenges and opportunities?

a.en: Challenges: risk of criticism, loss of control. Opportunities: audience support, valuable feedback.
a.ms: Cabaran: risiko kritikan, hilang kawalan. Peluang: sokongan audiens, maklum balas bernilai.

q.en: Five ways to work the backchannel?

a.en: Integrate social media; monitor and ask for feedback; review comments; auto-tweet key points; set expectations.
a.ms: Integrasi media sosial; pantau dan minta maklum balas; semak komen; tweet automatik; tetapkan jangkaan.

q.en: Advantages and disadvantages of online presentations?
q.ms: Kelebihan dan kekurangan pembentangan dalam talian?

a.en: Advantages: cost savings, convenience. Disadvantages: digital divide, loss of human moments.
a.ms: Kelebihan: jimat kos, kemudahan. Kekurangan: jurang digital, hilang detik manusiawi.

q.en: Six steps for successful online presentations?
q.ms: Enam langkah pembentangan dalam talian berjaya?

a.en: Send preview materials; rehearse; keep simple; ask feedback often; consider audience view; give time to connect.
a.ms: Hantar pratonton; berlatih; ringkas; minta maklum balas; fikir sudut audiens; beri masa bersambung.

q.en: Which is NOT a purpose of a presentation?

e.en: Inform, persuade, collaborate.

q.en: A U-shaped layout is called:

e.en: Horseshoe or U-shaped.

q.en: Which belongs to an audience profile?

e.en: Emotional state and comfort with your language.
e.ms: Keadaan emosi dan keselesaan dengan bahasa.

q.en: Shorter presentations with routine information use:
q.ms: Pembentangan pendek dengan maklumat rutin guna:

e.en: Direct for routine information or good news.
e.ms: Terus untuk maklumat rutin atau berita baik.

q.en: Which is part of a speaking outline?

e.en: Simplify, condense, add cues, arrange notes.
e.ms: Ringkas, padat, tambah isyarat, susun nota.

q.en: For a large audience on a platform, use a:
q.ms: Untuk audiens besar di pentas, guna:

e.en: Large: formal tone, limit participation.

o: Restate main points as a wrap-up

e.en: Restating is the close.

q.en: A good way to establish credibility is:

e.en: Also introduce yourself humbly and simply.
e.ms: Juga perkenal diri dengan rendah hati.

q.en: Which belongs to the body?

e.en: Body: main points, connect ideas, hold attention.
e.ms: Isi: poin utama, sambung idea, kekal perhatian.

q.en: A clear wrap-up belongs to the:

e.en: The close.

q.en: Speaking without preparation is:

e.en: Impromptu speaking.

q.en: Which is a tip to overcome anxiety?

e.en: Also visualise success and breathe.

q.en: To speak with confidence, you should:

e.en: Also controlled beginning, posture, nonverbal signals.
e.ms: Juga permulaan terkawal, postur, isyarat bukan lisan.

q.en: When handling questions, you should first:
q.ms: Semasa mengendali soalan, anda patut mula dengan:

e.en: Establish ground rules, prepare, notice nonverbal signals.
e.ms: Tetapkan peraturan asas, bersedia, perhati isyarat.

q.en: Preparing to speak includes:

e.en: Slide 26.

q.en: The backchannel is created by:

e.en: The audience creates this line of communication.

q.en: A backchannel CHALLENGE is:

e.en: Risk of criticism and loss of control.

q.en: A backchannel OPPORTUNITY is:

e.en: Audience support and valuable feedback.
e.ms: Sokongan audiens dan maklum balas bernilai.

q.en: Which helps work the backchannel?

e.en: Integrate, monitor, review, tweet, set expectations.
e.ms: Integrasi, pantau, semak, tweet, tetapkan jangkaan.

q.en: An online presentation DISADVANTAGE is:

e.en: Digital divide and loss of human moments.
e.ms: Jurang digital dan hilang detik manusiawi.

q.en: To ensure success online, you should:
q.ms: Untuk berjaya dalam talian, anda patut:

ms: Isi: sambung idea dan kekal perhatian (2)

Prepare to speak: seating, equipment, multicultural audiences (1)
